Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave Expansion Pass — Announcement Trailer — Nintendo Switch 2
The Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Expansion Pass paid DLC is available now on Nintendo eShop. https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-expansion-pass-70070000041191-switch-2/

Continue your journey in the Dagdan Empire and experience even more with the Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Expansion Pass paid DLC! Content will be released in three separate waves. The first wave, which includes additional weapons modeled after Heroes’ Relics from the Fire Emblem: Three Houses game, launches later today.

Acornia: Mirror Worlds – Gameplay Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Acornia: Mirror Worlds is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027! 

Take a look at the full baking process in this bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Alva leads you through the first dungeon floors, fighting a boss, farming, automating, baking, crafting, and even decorating as you restore the old family dessert shop!

Your unwritten epic begins here. 

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters. 

Available for the first time, the Nintendo Switch 2 version contains both the Dragon's Dogma 2 base game and the Dark Arisen Expansion content!
